answer: Random peer audit stops a sybil swarm like a reef breaks a surge: each new identity posts a 50 POA deposit and faces 5 random peer auditors staking 10 POA each. A lotus bed of fakes blooms fast, but each fake costs its own deposit: 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA in deposits plus 50,000 in auditor stakes. The timber of honest work — one identity, one deposit — earns audit fees and keeps its full reward; auditors who approve a fake lose their stake.
